newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold rates seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold rates seen mixed.

text.p: Pakistan gold rates are likely to remain mixed in the week starting Monday on low buying interest due to fluctuation of the rupee against the dollar in the kerb market, dealers said.
The fluctuation of the rupee would keep gold rates mixed, one dealer said.

Gold rates closed at 4,998 rupees per 10 grammes on Sunday compared to 5,066 on September 22 because of a low physical offtake following strengthening of the rupee against the dollar in the kerb market in the last week, one dealer said.
